title: ci: add /retrigger PR comment command
body:
fixes - [#28870](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28870)

#### Description
This PR introduces two changes:
1. **Retrigger CI Workflow:** Adds a new GitHub Actions workflow ([retrigger.yml](file:///e:/Open%20source%20Projects/podman/.github/workflows/retrigger.yml)) that listens for `/retrigger` comments on PRs. When a developer with `write` or `admin` permissions leaves the `/retrigger` comment, the workflow will rerun completed workflow checks for the PR's head commit, and cancel-then-rerun any active checks.

Hey @prakharsingh-74,I had a look at this since it overlaps with what I've been reading in CI. I think the `if [ -z "$trigger_line" ] `guard in the parse step can't be reached - Actions runs `run:` under `bash -e`, so when grep finds no match the assignment exits 1 and the step dies right there. 

Since the job-level `if` uses `contains()`, a comment that just mentions /retrigger mid-sentence would leave a red X on the PR. `|| true `on the grep should fix it.
